# Debug Existing Failure

Analyze the failure before modifying code.

1. Reproduce the issue if possible.
2. Identify the root cause.
3. Check related tests and existing patterns.
4. Explain why the current behavior is wrong.
5. Propose the smallest fix.
6. Implement it.
7. Add a regression test when appropriate.
8. Run relevant tests.
9. Summarize the root cause and fix.

Do not modify unrelated files.
